statBlock.name: Fire Elemental Myrmidon
statBlock.description: Ritual magic binds a fire elemental into a suit of plate armor, leaving it to fight at its creator’s command.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Languages: Ignan and one language chosen by its creator.
sections.Traits:
Illumination. The myrmidon casts bright light within 20 ft. and dim light out to 40 ft.
Magic Weapons. Its weapon attacks are magical.
Water Susceptibility. Whenever it moves 5 ft. through water at least 1 ft. deep, it takes 2 (1d4) cold damage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Scimitar attacks.
Scimitar. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage.
Fiery Strikes (Recharge 6). Use Multiattack and add 5 (1d10) fire damage to each hit.

statBlock.name: Fraz-Urb’luu
statBlock.description: The demon lord of illusions wears false identities even when dealing with his own cultists. He looks like a long-necked, winged gargoyle in his true form.

sections.Damage immunities: Poison. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical sources.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Fraz-Urb’luu can choose to succeed when he fails a saving throw.
Magic Resistance. He has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. His weapon attacks are magical.
Undetectable. Divination magic cannot target him, magical scrying sensors cannot reveal him, and abilities that sense demons or fiends cannot detect him.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma (spell save DC 23). No material components.
At will. Alter Self (can become Medium when changing his appearance), Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Phantasmal Force.
3/day each. Confusion, Dream, Mislead, Programmed Illusion, Seeming.
1/day each. Mirage Arcane, Modify Memory, Project Image.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and two Fist attacks.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 19 (3d6 + 9) piercing damage.
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 22 (3d8 + 9) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Legendary actions:
Three legendary actions are available. Use one option at the end of another creature’s turn. Spent actions return at the start of this creature’s turn.
Tail (1 action). Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 20 (2d10 + 9) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature hit by the tail is grappled (escape DC 24) and restrained while grappled. The tail can hold only one creature at a time.
Phantasmal Killer (2 actions). Cast Phantasmal Killer without needing concentration.
sections.Lair: Zoragmelok is a circular fortress of twisted towers and domes in Hollow’s Heart. Fraz-Urb’luu is CR 24 (62,000 XP) when encountered in his lair.
sections.Lair actions:
On initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one option. The same option cannot be used two rounds in a row.
Move doors. Replace up to five doors within the lair with wall and open the same number of new doors in previously solid walls.
Simulacrum. Copy one humanoid within the lair as if by Simulacrum. The copy appears instantly, follows Fraz-Urb’luu’s commands, and is destroyed on the next initiative count 20.
Wave of anguish. Each creature he can see within the lair takes 33 (6d10) psychic damage if it fails a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw.
sections.Regional effects:
Intelligent creatures within 1 mile of the lair often glimpse dead friends or comrades that disappear almost immediately.
Within 6 miles, warped roads and paths loop back on themselves and make travel difficult.
A humanoid that spends at least 1 hour within 1 mile must pass a DC 23 Wisdom saving throw or gain a flaw from Madness of Fraz-Urb’luu. A successful save grants immunity to this effect for 24 hours.
These effects fade over 1d10 days after Fraz-Urb’luu dies.
sections.Madness of Fraz-Urb’luu:
If a creature goes mad in the lair or within Fraz-Urb’luu’s line of sight, roll d100 for a flaw. It lasts until cured.
01–20. The creature hides the truth about its intentions and actions even when honesty would help.
21–40. Hallucinations and episodes of catatonia come and go.
41–60. The creature drifts into elaborate daydreams and has trouble telling them apart from actual memories.
61–80. The creature holds on to a belief even in the face of overwhelming evidence.
81–100. The creature’s perception of reality differs from everyone else’s, leading to violent delusions.

statBlock.name: Frost Salamander
statBlock.description: This Frostfell predator digs through ice and follows heat. A lit forge or campfire can draw it out of its tunnels.

sections.Traits: Burning Fury. Taking fire damage immediately recharges Freezing Breath.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make four Claws attacks and one Bite attack.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) cold damage.
Freezing Breath (Recharge 6). Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failure it takes 44 (8d10) cold damage. It takes half as much on a success.

statBlock.name: Geryon
statBlock.description: An archdevil and relentless hunter who rules from Coldsteel and vies with Levistus for control of Stygia.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Geryon can choose to succeed when he fails a saving throw.
Magic Resistance. He has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
Magic Weapons. His weapon attacks are magical.
Regeneration. Geryon regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. Radiant damage prevents this recovery at the start of his next turn. He dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and fails to regenerate.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Charisma (spell save DC 21). No material components.
At will. Alter Self (can become Medium when changing his appearance), Detect Magic, Geas, Ice Storm, Invisibility (self only), Locate Object, Suggestion, Wall of Ice.
1/day each. Divine Word, Symbol (pain only).
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Claws attack and one Stinger attack.
Claws. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 23 (4d6 + 9) slashing damage. A Large or smaller target is grappled (escape DC 24) and restrained until the grapple ends. Geryon can grapple one creature at a time. A target he was already grappling takes another 27 (6d8) slashing damage.
Stinger. Melee weapon attack, +16 to hit, reach 20 ft., one creature. A hit deals 14 (2d4 + 9) piercing damage. On a failed DC 21 Constitution saving throw, the target also takes 13 (2d12) poison damage and is poisoned until it finishes a short or long rest. Its hit point maximum drops by half the poison damage taken and recovers when the poisoned condition ends. A target dies if its hit point maximum reaches 0.
Teleport. Magically move up to 120 ft. to a visible unoccupied space. Worn and carried equipment comes with Geryon.
sections.Legendary actions:
Three legendary actions are available. Use one option at the end of another creature’s turn. Spent actions return at the start of this creature’s turn.
Infernal Glare (1 action). Choose a visible creature within 60 ft. If it can see Geryon, it must pass a DC 23 Wisdom save or be frightened of him until the end of its next turn.
Swift Sting (2 actions). Make one Stinger attack.
Teleport (1 action). Use Teleport.
sections.Lair actions:
On initiative count 20, losing ties, choose one option. The same option cannot be used two rounds in a row.
Cold burst. Center a 10-ft. cube on a point Geryon can see within 120 ft. Each creature in the cube takes 28 (8d6) cold damage on a failed DC 21 Constitution save.
Turn on an ally. Choose one creature Geryon can see within 60 ft. On a failed DC 21 Wisdom save, it is restrained for 1 minute. It can end the effect on itself by dealing damage to an ally.
Banishment. Geryon casts Banishment.
sections.Regional effects:
Within 1 mile, intelligent creatures often see shimmering portals to places they consider safe. Entering one deposits the traveler somewhere in Stygia. Freezing winds and howls fill the same area.
A creature that finishes a short or long rest within 1 mile must pass a DC 21 Wisdom save or get no benefit from that rest.
These effects fade over 1d10 days after Geryon dies.
sections.Optional variant: Sound the Horn (1/day). Summon 5d4 Minotaurs in unoccupied spaces Geryon chooses within 600 ft. They roll initiative on arrival and remain until they die or he uses an action to dismiss any or all of them.

statBlock.name: Giff
statBlock.description: Hippo-headed mercenaries drill in regiments and often ask to be paid in gunpowder. Their contracts let them sit out fights against other giff.

sections.Traits:
Headfirst Charge. After the giff moves at least 20 ft. in a straight line and ends within 5 ft. of a Large or smaller creature, it can force that creature to make a DC 14 Strength saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and falls prone.
Firearms Knowledge. The giff ignores the loading property of muskets and pistols.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Pistol attacks.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) if used with two hands.
Musket. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d12 + 2) piercing damage.
Pistol. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.
Fragmentation Grenade (1/day). Throw the grenade up to 60 ft. Each creature within 20 ft. of its detonation makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) piercing damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Gunpowder by the Keg: As one action, the giff lights a keg and can throw it up to 15 ft. It explodes at the start of the giff’s next turn. Each creature within 20 ft. makes a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure it takes 24 (7d6) fire damage and is knocked prone. On a success it takes half as much damage and the explosion does not knock it prone. Each other keg within 20 ft. has a 50 percent chance of exploding. Check each keg at most once per turn.
